conditions.label: Knee pain
conditions.description: Discomfort in one or both knees.
safe_alternatives: Stationary cycling at an easy pace
conditions.notes: General information only. Move within a comfortable range, stop if something hurts, and follow your doctor's or physiotherapist's guidance.

conditions.label: Back pain
conditions.description: Discomfort in the lower or upper back.
safe_alternatives: Slow core-stability moves such as bird-dog
conditions.notes: Keep movements slow and controlled, and stop if you feel pain. Ask your doctor which activities are suitable for you.

conditions.label: Neck or shoulder pain
conditions.description: Stiffness or discomfort around the neck or shoulders.
safe_alternatives: Light band work below shoulder height
Gentle shoulder rolls within a comfortable range
Core exercises that do not load the neck
conditions.notes: Avoid positions that increase discomfort. Check with your doctor if the pain continues.

conditions.label: Diabetes
safe_alternatives: Regular low-to-moderate activity such as walking
conditions.notes: Talk to your doctor about exercise and meal timing that is right for you. This app does not give medicine or blood sugar advice.

conditions.label: High blood pressure
conditions.description: Blood pressure that is higher than recommended.
safe_alternatives: Light resistance work with steady breathing
conditions.notes: Breathe steadily and avoid holding your breath during effort. Ask your doctor what activity level suits you.

conditions.label: Asthma
safe_alternatives: Strength work with plenty of rest breaks
conditions.notes: Warm up gradually, rest when you need to, and follow your doctor's advice about exercising.

conditions.label: Heart condition
safe_alternatives: Short, easy walks if your doctor agrees
conditions.notes: Please get your doctor's approval before starting or changing any exercise. Stop and seek medical help if you feel unwell.

conditions.label: Other
conditions.description: A condition that is not listed here.
safe_alternatives: Start with gentle walking and stretching
conditions.notes: If you have a condition that is not listed, please check with your doctor before starting a program.
